corrections.text: The Phys.org source used for all quotes attributed to Surendra Padamata and Nathan Keim, and for details such as the paper's 'editors' suggestion' status and researcher affiliations, returned an HTTP 403 to the newsroom's archiver and is not preserved as a provenance snapshot. The Chief Editor confirmed every Phys.org-attributed quote and claim verbatim against the live article at review time; readers should note these claims rest on a live verification rather than an archived snapshot. The article's other technical claims (the abstract wording, author list, and journal citation Phys. Rev. Lett. 136, 258201) are backed by an archived, hash-verified arXiv snapshot.
